pages.text: Schedule the child action after a delay measured in game ticks. Normally, 20 ticks equal one second.

pages.title: Default Aether Cost
pages.text: Only the connected nodes contribute; this node adds no aether fee.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.15 + H(t) + C, for delay t in ticks and action cost C. No repeated waiting fee.
